meta_description:
318K Followers, 380 Following, 1,429 Posts - Khan Academy (@khanacademy) on Instagram: "Free online education for anyone, anywhere! 🆓
Learn math, science, art, history & more. 📚💻
Follow for study tips, inspiration & giveaways! ✨"

posts.meta_description:
313 likes, 5 comments - khanacademy on September 23, 2026: "How do you investigate something the size of a Parade balloon? Start small. 🎈

In this free, hands-on STEAM activity, students use balloon models to explore balanced forces, then apply what they learn to explain how giant balloons stay in place and design a Parade balloon of their own. Free teacher and student guides are included.

Explore the activity 🔗Link in bio! 

Then let their ideas take flight. Teachers and families can share finished student artwork, with permission, using #MacysParade.

Created by Khan Academy with support from Macy’s in celebration of the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade®.".

82 likes, 57 comments - khanacademy on October 19, 2026: "🎁 45 teachers will each win a $100 Amazon gift card!

Gem Challenges give everyday learning a shared destination. You choose a class reward, and the lessons, exercises, and assessments students complete move the whole class closer.

To enter:
💎 Tag one adult teacher friend
🎉 Finish this sentence in the same comment:
“If our class reaches its Gem goal, we’re celebrating with ______.”

Each distinct eligible comment counts as one entry, with up to five entries per person. Enter by October 30 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

Setting a class reward is not required to enter.

No purchase necessary. Open to eligible U.S. K to 12 teachers and school based educators age 18 or older. See Official Rules at the link in bio.".
